# Couch to 5k

The very beginning. NHS C25K app (Laura's voice), 3 runs a week, 9 weeks. I was 36, hadn't run since high school gym class, and had just been lapped by a 70-year-old with walking poles on the Humber trail.

## Weeks 1 to 3
- 2024-01-08 W1R1: 60 s run / 90 s walk × 8, Sunnyside boardwalk, -6°C, lungs on fire. Felt amazing after.
- 2024-01-10 W1R2: treadmill at the YMCA, easier, more boring
- 2024-01-17 W2R2: 90 s / 2 min, calves sore for 2 days
- 2024-01-26 W3R3: 3 min runs! Did it! HR hit 182 and I genuinely thought I'd die

## Weeks 4 to 6
- 2024-02-02 W4R1: 5 min runs. Had to stop once on the second one, repeated the run on Sunday
- 2024-02-09 Bought real shoes, Brooks Ghost 15, $170 at Running Room after the gait thing
- 2024-02-16 W5R3: the famous 20 minutes non-stop. Cried at the end, a man walking a dachshund gave me a thumbs up
- 2024-02-28 W6R3: 25 min, 3.4 km, pace 7:21/km

## Weeks 7 to 9
- 2024-03-06 W7R1: 25 min, felt easy for the first time ever
- 2024-03-13 W8R2: 28 min, rained the whole way, loved it
- 2024-03-20 W9R2: 30 min, 4.3 km
- 2024-03-23 graduation run, High Park loop: 5.0 km in 36:41, avg HR 168. Dev waited at the Grenadier Café with a hot chocolate.

## After
- 2024-04-06 first Sunnybrook parkrun: 33:58, finisher token #A1294618
- 2024-05-04 joined the High Park Harriers Tuesday beginner group, coach Marguerite Osei
- 2024-06-15 5k PB 30:12
- 2024-09-22 first 10k, Longboat Toronto Island Run, 1:04:50
- 2025-03-01 signed up for the Toronto Waterfront marathon, which is how I ended up writing [[Marathon taper]] notes

## What I'd tell my January self
- walk breaks are not cheating
- slow is fine, conversation pace, the app doesn't care about speed
- the wheezing in May was birch pollen, not unfitness ([[Seasonal allergies]])
- add the post-run routine from [[Mobility routine]] earlier, the calves would have thanked me
- it's in my [[Gratitude list]] for a reason
